description: Questions a developer might ask, each with the proposal that answers it. Minimums are set below measured performance with a margin, and a ranker that falls under any of them fails.

cases.query: naming conventions for functions and variables
embed expressions inside string literals
assign a variable inside an expression
match statement with case patterns
coroutines declared with async and await
generate __init__ and __repr__ for classes that hold data
annotate the types of function parameters
isolated environment with its own site-packages
enumeration of named constant members
parameters that can only be passed by position
merge two dictionaries with the pipe operator
structural subtyping without explicit inheritance
dictionary type with a fixed set of keys
raise and handle several unrelated exceptions at once
remove a prefix or suffix from a string
zip that raises when the iterables have different lengths
parse TOML in the standard library
make the global interpreter lock optional
acquire and release resources with a with statement
delegate to a subgenerator
secure random tokens for passwords
underscores as visual separators in numeric literals
declare build system requirements in pyproject
mark a method as overriding its parent
annotate a method that returns an instance of its own class
operator for matrix multiplication
conventions for writing docstrings
attach extra notes to an exception
point at the exact expression that failed in a traceback

minimums_note: Set on 2026-10-01 below measured performance (capped: 0.966 / 0.823 / 0.966; bm25: 0.931 / 0.879 / 0.931) with a margin, so a real regression fails and noise does not.
